headings.description: Used for primary screen titles, game titles, and VIP messaging to give a high-roller classic casino feel.

body.description: Clean, modern geometric sans-serif to contrast the heavy serif headings. Highly legible for menus, settings, and smaller text.

numbers.description: For the lottery numbers themselves. Bold, elegant, giving weight to the winning numbers.

rules: Overlines must be uppercase, tracking-[0.2em], text-xs.
Use fluid typography for hero sections.
Never use pure black #000000; use #050505 to keep it rich.
Use subtle gold borders for premium cards.
Ensure contrast ratio is > 4.5:1 for normal text.
Active/Hover states should lighten the background or increase gold border opacity.

visual_effects.glassmorphism: Used for sticky headers and bottom nav. bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-xl border-t border-white/5.
visual_effects.glow: Used for VIP buttons and winning numbers. drop-shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(212,175,55,0.4)].
visual_effects.shimmer: CSS animation sliding a linear gradient across gold text/buttons to simulate light reflection.
visual_effects.gradients: Avoid flat gradients. Use radial gradients to simulate spotlighting on cards (e.g., center light fading to dark edges).

spacing_and_layout.container: w-full max-w-md mx-auto min-h-screen relative overflow-x-hidden shadow-2xl
spacing_and_layout.bento_grid: Used for Home screen statistics and hot/cold numbers. Dense, rounded-2xl cards with 1px gold borders.

buttons.primary: bg-gradient-to-r from-[#D4AF37] to-[#FADB5F] text-black font-semibold rounded-full px-6 py-3 shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(212,175,55,0.3)] hover:scale-105 transition-transform
buttons.vip: bg-[#050505] border border-[#D4AF37] text-[#D4AF37] font-semibold rounded-full px-6 py-3 hover:bg-[#D4AF37]/10 transition-colors
buttons.secondary: bg-white/5 text-white font-medium rounded-full px-6 py-3 hover:bg-white/10 transition-colors

components.lottery_ball: w-12 h-12 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center text-xl font-bold font-serif shadow-inner bg-gradient-to-br from-[#FADB5F] to-[#997A00] text-black border border-white/20
components.inputs: bg-black/50 border border-white/10 rounded-xl px-4 py-3 text-white focus:border-[#D4AF37] focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#D4AF37] transition-all outline-none
components.bottom_nav: fixed bottom-0 w-full max-w-md mx-auto left-0 right-0 bg-black/90 backdrop-blur-lg border-t border-white/10 flex justify-around py-4 pb-safe z-50
components.testing: All buttons, inputs, tabs, and interactive cards MUST have data-testid attributes.

media_and_images.description: Glowing neon slot machine drum spinning. Use as the background for the Quick Pick number generation screen.
Abstract luxury emerald green felt texture with gold geometry. Use for the Paywall / VIP Subscription screen.
Close-up of golden lottery balls. Use in the history screen header or as a visual flair on the home screen.
Luxurious casino interior/roulette table. Apply heavy dark overlay (bg-black/70) and use as background for Login/Register.

Auth.layout: Full screen with background image + heavy dark overlay. Center-aligned form. Must feel exclusive like entering a private club.
elements: Brand Logo/Title (Playfair Display, Gold gradient)
Email & Password Inputs
Primary Login/Register Button (Gold CTA)
Link to switch between Login and Register

Home.layout: Scrollable page with sticky bottom nav. Padding top for safe area.
elements: Greeting Header with user name
Big Hero CTA Card for 'Generate Lucky Numbers' (Emerald Green or Velvet Burgundy background, gold subtle border, absolute positioned graphics)
Horizontal Scroll or Grid of 4 Game Selectors (6/58, 6/55, 6/52, 6/50) - styled as casino playing cards with metallic sheen
Recent generated picks section (mini lottery balls row)

Generate_Selector.layout: Tabbed view or split screen for 'Quick Pick' vs 'AI Lucky Picks'. Header overlaps background.
elements: Tabs: Quick Pick (Free) | AI Premium (Locked/VIP)
Quick Pick: Large slot machine animation area. Massive 'SPIN' button.
AI Lucky Picks: Form inputs for Birthday (Date picker), Zodiac sign (Select), Favorite numbers. CTA 'Analyze & Predict'.

Results_Screen.layout: Modal or slide-up sheet. Cinematic presentation of numbers in the center of the screen.
elements: Confetti/Shimmer effect background animation
Row of 6 Lottery Balls (Gold or Ruby red depending on game)
Hot/Cold indicators underneath balls (if AI Pick was used)
Action buttons: Save Pick, Share, Generate Again

VIP_Paywall.layout: Full screen premium showcase using the emerald/gold background image.
elements: VIP Crown Icon or Logo
Title: 'Become a High Roller'
Benefits list: AI Hot/Cold Analysis, Unlimited Premium Picks, Ad-free Experience
Pricing tiers: One-time Pass vs Monthly VIP (High contrast active states)
Stripe Checkout CTA

History.layout: List view with subtle card separators.
elements: Chronological list of saved/generated picks
Each item shows: Date, Game Type, Numbers (mini balls), Tag (Quick Pick or AI)

Profile.layout: Simple vertical list of settings and user info in bento grid style.
elements: Avatar/Email display area
VIP Status indicator (Gold badge if active, Greyed out if not)
Settings links, Logout button

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure the app is constrained to a max-width of `md` (approx 448px) and centered on larger screens to strictly emulate a mobile layout (using `mx-auto max-w-md min-h-screen bg-black relative`).
Use Phosphor Icons or Lucide React for crisp, premium iconography. Use Phosphor Icons preferably for the elegant duotone/fill options.
Implement Framer Motion for slot machine spinning numbers and modal page transitions.
Do not use default Shadcn styles blindly. Override them heavily to match the dark casino aesthetic. Strip out generic gray borders.
The 4 Toto games (6/58, 6/55, 6/52, 6/50) are core logic. Generate exactly 6 random numbers based on the selected game's max number (e.g., 1-58 for 6/58 Toto).
All backgrounds and colors MUST adhere to the Jewel & Luxury Archetype. NO plain white screens.
ALWAYS preserve the exact image URLs provided in the media section. Do not use placehold.it or similar.
Data test IDs are strictly required on all user interactable elements.
Use standard HTML inputs customized with Tailwind for the Auth forms if Shadcn forms are too rigid for the design.
Typography: Import 'Playfair Display' and 'Outfit' from Google Fonts and configure them in tailwind.config.js.
